name: PLS File Explorer
tagline: A complete offline file manager for your phone and your PC. No ads, no tracking, no account.
overview: PLS File Explorer (shown on the phone as PLS Explorer) is a full file manager for Android, built in the spirit of the classic ES File Explorer without the ads, tracking or hidden servers that ruined it. Browse your phone Windows-style with a folder tree, sort and group every way Windows can, open and make zip files with its own archive engine, view pictures and text, check sizes and checksums, clean up storage, and keep deleted files in a Recycle Bin for 30 days. No account, no subscription, core free. On Windows (in testing since Nov 20, 2026), PLS File Explorer adds two panes side by side and the PC tools: an exact duplicate finder that always protects the original, a disguised-file finder that flags programs dressed up as pictures or documents, a cleanup that lists every file before anything goes to the Recycle Bin, PLS Zip, and your phone as a drive through PLS Link.

capabilities.title: Setup guide
capabilities.text: On first run a short guide asks only for what the app needs: folder access, notifications, and optional nearby-device access. Optional steps can be skipped.

proofs.caption: Setup guide: four steps, optional ones marked

capabilities.title: Home
capabilities.text: Storage used and free, a device health card, search, Favorites and Recent, the four main folders, and one-tap clean-up tools.

capabilities.title: Browse folders
capabilities.text: Back, Forward, Up and Home buttons, a clickable path, how full the drive is, and a status line with item count, sort order and position. Grid or list view.

proofs.caption: A demo folder in grid view with picture and PDF previews

capabilities.title: Sort and group, Windows-style
capabilities.text: Sort by name, dates, type, size and more, either direction, and group by date, type, size, folder or name ranges.

proofs.caption: After: list view by size, grouped by type

capabilities.title: Folder tree and Newest In
capabilities.text: A folder tree rooted at the device name sits beside the files, with Newest In at the top: the newest files on the phone, wherever they landed.

proofs.caption: The tree on the left (Newest In, device, Internal storage)

capabilities.title: Tap a file: every action in one place
capabilities.text: Tap a file for Open, Open with, Share, Send by Bluetooth, Extract, Zip with a password, Copy, Move, Rename, Delete, Hide and Properties.

proofs.caption: The tap-a-file menu on a zip

capabilities.title: Open and extract archives
capabilities.text: Open a zip, then extract it into the same folder, a new folder named after it, or any folder you pick, with a rule for files that already exist. A report says what came out.

proofs.caption: Extract to: where, keep structure, name clashes
Extracted: what, where, how long, what is inside

capabilities.title: Make zips, with or without a password
capabilities.text: Zip files or folders, pick the name, folder and level, and lock it with an AES-256 password.

capabilities.title: Its own archive engine
capabilities.text: Reads 7z, RAR (old and new, solid, passwords), TAR, GZ, BZ2 and archives split into parts, with no outside libraries.

capabilities.title: Text viewer and editor
capabilities.text: Open text files in a built-in editor with line numbers, undo and redo, find, save and encoding.

capabilities.title: Picture viewer
capabilities.text: Pictures open full screen with Share and Delete and a strip of the other pictures in the folder.

proofs.caption: A demo picture with the folder strip below

capabilities.title: Properties and checksums
capabilities.text: Type, exact size, location and all three dates, a read-only switch, and MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 checksums you can copy.

proofs.caption: Checksums (the SHA-256 matched the file on the bench)

capabilities.title: Recycle Bin
capabilities.text: Deleted files wait 30 days. Restore them, or delete them for good behind a confirm.

proofs.caption: A deleted demo file, where it came from and days left

capabilities.title: Copy, move, rename, new folder
capabilities.text: Copy and move with progress, speed and time left, a choice when names clash, rename many at once, and new folders and text files.

capabilities.title: Search
capabilities.text: Search the whole phone or one folder, with filters for type, date and size, results grouped by folder.

capabilities.title: Storage map
capabilities.text: What fills the phone by kind (videos, pictures, documents, archives, other, system) with sizes and percentages, plus the biggest files and folders.

proofs.caption: Storage map of the test bench

capabilities.title: Clean-up tools
capabilities.text: Cleaner, File analyzer, Duplicate finder and Disguised file finder, each showing exactly what it found before anything is removed.

capabilities.title: Images, Videos, Audio, Documents, Apps
capabilities.text: Category pages for every kind of file, with picture sizes from Full to Tiny and sortable list columns.

capabilities.title: App manager and installer
capabilities.text: See installed apps, back them up, uninstall, and install APK files with a clear page that says newer, same or older than what is installed.

capabilities.title: Music and video player
capabilities.text: Plays music and video with an equalizer, loop A to B, lyrics, a waveform on the progress line, and its own engine for AVI, FLV, AIFF and tracker music.

capabilities.title: Device health
capabilities.text: Battery, temperature, storage and more on a live device page.

capabilities.title: Phone to PC over Wi-Fi
capabilities.text: Start a password-protected local transfer page for a computer on your own Wi-Fi, or pair the PLS Link PC app once. Off until you start it, shown on screen while it runs.

capabilities.title: Bluetooth and USB drives
capabilities.text: Send files by Bluetooth and browse USB sticks plugged into the phone.

capabilities.title: Lock, hide and encrypt
capabilities.text: PIN or fingerprint lock, a hide list, and files locked with a password (AES-256).

capabilities.title: Light and dark in one tap
capabilities.text: The half-circle button flips every screen between dark and light.

capabilities.title: Settings, looks and backup
capabilities.text: Settings for display, colors and fonts, notifications, Recycle Bin and security, with backup and restore of your settings.

capabilities.title: Help and Report a problem
capabilities.text: An illustrated manual and a Report a problem form that opens an email you review before sending.

capabilities.title: No ads, no tracking, no account
capabilities.text: No ads, no analytics, no call-home, no account and no subscription. The only network use is the local transfer you start yourself.

capabilities.title: Windows: two panes, tabs, Grid with pictures
capabilities.text: Two folders side by side, each pane with its own tabs and a clickable path. Details or Grid view with the same pictures Windows shows. Newest (everything that landed on this PC lately), Recent and Favorites sit at the top of This PC. Copy or move to the other pane with Windows' own progress and replace prompts.

proofs.caption: Windows: Grid with real thumbnails and two tabs on the left, Newest on the right (farm test machine)

capabilities.title: Windows: duplicates with a protected original
capabilities.text: Exact copies, checked byte for byte. One copy of every set is the protected original and can never be ticked; pick oldest copy or shortest folder path, or name Protected folders whose files always win.

capabilities.title: Windows: disguised files
capabilities.text: Reads the first bytes of every file. DANGER marks a program dressed up as something else (a .jpg that is really a program, invoice.pdf.exe, names written backwards); HIDDEN marks a picture or video with the wrong ending, fixed in one click.

capabilities.title: Windows: cleanup that shows every file
capabilities.text: Temporary files, crash dumps, empty folders and extra copies come ticked; old installers and very big files are listed unticked. Every single file is shown first and everything goes to the Recycle Bin.

capabilities.title: Windows: PLS Zip, its own engine
capabilities.text: Makes zips; opens zip, tar, gz, 7z (every common method, passwords, hidden names), RAR 2.9 to 5 (solid, passwords), tar.bz2, bz2 and archives split into parts. No outside code; every 7z and RAR file checked against its checksum; never overwrites, never writes outside its new folder.

capabilities.title: Windows: your phone as a drive
capabilities.text: Pair your phone once; after that it shows in This PC next to your drives whenever it's on the same Wi-Fi. Open it like a drive, copy either way, drag PC files onto a phone folder. Encrypted; the link never deletes anything on the phone.

capabilities.title: Windows: About, updates, look, crash log
capabilities.text: About and Check for updates first; dark, light or follow Windows; font size; show hidden files; one-tap crash log through your own email app.

capabilities.title: Windows: compare folders
capabilities.text: The two folders open in Files, everything inside: only on one side, newer where, the same. Tick lines and copy them across with Windows' own copy window.

capabilities.title: Windows: folder sizes
capabilities.text: What fills a folder or a whole drive, biggest first, as red bars; double-click a folder to look inside.

capabilities.title: Windows: tree, find, rename many
capabilities.text: A folder tree beside each pane; Find filters as you type or searches every folder inside; Rename many shows every new name in a live preview before anything changes, and undoes the last batch.

capabilities.title: Windows: one Setup, no admin
capabilities.text: Installs for you in a minute, over an older copy, adds Microsoft's .NET 11 runtime if the PC needs it, and removes cleanly from Installed apps.
